description: Hip joint contact force versus gait cycle phase, normalized to body weight (BW). Digitized representative curves from instrumented implant telemetry.
source: Bergmann et al. 2001, Journal of Biomechanics 34(7):859-871, HIP98 dataset. Stumble peak from Bergmann et al. 2004.

notes.stumble_frequency: Roughly 1 stumble event per 1000 gait cycles in an elderly cohort.
